newMessages.content: The Phase 3 protocol is locked and site activation is underway. Is there anything else on the clinical program?

Actually yes — the DSMB flagged a hepatotoxicity signal in the Phase 2 long-term follow-up data. We need to reopen the Phase 2 dosing analysis. Specifically, I want to look at whether the 400mg cohort had disproportionate ALT elevations compared to 200mg, and whether we need to amend the Phase 3 dose selection.
